intro.h2: From a 1970s kitchen to a clean, modern one
paragraphs: KGF Home Improvement handles kitchen remodeling Westland homeowners hire when they want a local crew instead of a company that is always on TV. Their Facebook page describes skilled finish carpentry, with a specialty in kitchen remodeling and cabinet spraying. Estimates are free.

One first-time homeowner said KGF took their kitchen and bathroom from an outdated 1970s look to a cleaner, finished, modern one, after helping them with ideas and a clear direction. Another praised trim work with a flawless finish and cabinets that exceeded expectations. Reviewers describe a family-oriented, professional company that answers every question and gets the details right.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Westland, plus cabinets and trim

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen remodeling is one of two specialties listed on their Facebook page. KGF helps you settle on ideas and a direction, then carries out the upgrade. One client went from an outdated 1970s kitchen to a cleaner, more modern look they say they absolutely love.

image.alt: Wall of tall white painted shaker cabinets with black bar pulls next to a stainless refrigerator

items.name: Cabinet spraying and refinishing
items.blurb: Cabinet spraying is their other named specialty. A sprayed finish lays down smooth and even, without brush marks, so existing cabinets can look new without being replaced. One reviewer recommends them for cabinet refinishing and said the craftsmanship exceeded expectations.

image.alt: Close-up of white shaker cabinet doors with a smooth painted finish and brass bar pulls

items.name: Cabinet installation
items.blurb: New cabinets need to go in level, square and tight to the wall. A Google reviewer recommends KGF for cabinet installation, and their photos show full-height pantry cabinets fitted neatly beside the refrigerator. Ask about installing new cabinets as part of a kitchen update.

items.name: Trim and finish carpentry
items.blurb: Finish carpentry is how the company describes itself. A reviewer called their trim work outstanding, with incredible attention to detail and a flawless finish. Trim is often the last thing you notice and the first thing that makes a room look finished.

items.name: Bathroom upgrades
items.blurb: KGF has upgraded bathrooms along with kitchens. One couple had both rooms modernized at the same time and said they absolutely love the results. Call to talk through what you would like to change in your bathroom and get a free estimate.

items.title: Local, not on TV
items.text: One couple weighed a big company that is always on TV against someone local, and chose KGF. They describe it as a family-oriented, professional company.

items.title: Help for first-time owners
items.text: A first-time homeowner said KGF helped with ideas and a proper direction to get the look they wanted, and answered all of their questions along the way.

items.title: Detail in the finish
items.text: Reviewers keep mentioning attention to detail: outstanding trim, a flawless finish and cabinets that exceeded expectations. Every Google review is five stars.

items.title: Free estimates
items.text: Their Facebook page offers free estimates. Call Monday to Saturday between 7 AM and 7 PM to set one up and talk through your kitchen or bath.

about.h2: About Kyle and KGF Home Improvement
about.text: KGF Home Improvement is a finish carpentry and home improvement company based in Westland, Michigan, specializing in kitchen remodeling and cabinet spraying. Customers know the owner as Kyle, and one describes him as exceptionally polite and understanding with any concerns. Its latest Google reviews all came in during the last few months, and the work is already drawing repeat business: one couple who had their kitchen and bathroom upgraded is planning their basement next. Reviewers call KGF professional, reliable, responsive and easy to work with from start to finish.

items.name: James F.
items.text: KGF upgraded our kitchen and bathroom. As a first time homeowner, KGF helped us with ideas and a proper direction to achieve our upgrades with the look we wanted. KGF answered all our questions and overproduced with craftsmanship. I believe the owner's name is Kyle, who was exceptionally polite and understanding with any concerns we had. We went from a outdated 1970s look to now a more cleaner, finished, modern look. We absolutely love our new kitchen and bathroom. I absolutely would recommend KGF to any homeowners. We were troubled on deciding on going with a company that's always on TV or not. We decided we wanted somebody more local. We're so glad we found KGF. They are more of a family, oriented, professional company. Thank you KGF. Will be seeing you soon for our basement upgrades. ⭐ x'5

items.name: James T.
items.text:
I had an excellent experience with KGF Home Improvement! Their trim work was outstanding, with incredible attention to detail and a flawless finish. They also did an amazing job on my cabinets, and the quality of the craftsmanship exceeded my expectations.

What really set them apart was their customer service. They were professional, responsive, and easy to work with from start to finish. They took the time to answer all my questions and made sure everything was done exactly the way I wanted.

If you’re looking for high-quality trim work, cabinet installation or refinishing, and a company that truly cares about its customers, I highly recommend KGF Home Improvement. I couldn’t be happier with the results!

items.name: Gage L.
items.text: KGF Improvement did an excellent job from start to finish. They were professional, reliable, and paid great attention to detail. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for home improvement services. Great experience!

service_area.text: KGF Home Improvement is a local company based in Westland, the town listed on its Facebook page. It does not list a storefront, so the crew comes to you. If you are in or around Westland and want to update a kitchen, refinish cabinets, add trim or upgrade a bathroom, call (734) 502-4805 to check whether your address fits the schedule and to book a free estimate.

items.q: Can you refinish my cabinets instead of replacing them?
items.a: Yes. Cabinet spraying is one of the two specialties on KGF's Facebook page, and a Google reviewer recommends them for cabinet refinishing. Spraying gives a smooth, even finish. Whether your existing boxes and doors are good candidates is something Kyle can check during the free estimate.

Yes. Their Facebook page says free estimates. Call (734) 502-4805 Monday through Saturday between 7 AM and 7 PM, or email kyle.ferguson13@icloud.com with a few photos of the room and a short description of what you would like done. Kyle can then come out to look.

items.q: I'm a first-time homeowner and not sure what I want. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. A first-time homeowner wrote that KGF helped them with ideas and a proper direction to get the look they wanted, and answered all of their questions. They went from an outdated 1970s kitchen and bathroom to a cleaner, more modern look.

items.q: Do you do trim and finish carpentry?
items.a: Yes. KGF describes itself as skilled finish carpentry and home improvement. A reviewer called their trim work outstanding, with incredible attention to detail and a flawless finish. Trim can be part of a kitchen or bath remodel or a separate project on its own.

KGF is based in Westland, Michigan, the town listed on its Facebook page, and works at customers' homes rather than from a storefront. If you are nearby and are not sure whether you are in range, call and ask. Google lists hours of Monday to Saturday, 7 AM to 7 PM.

final_cta.text: Call Kyle for a free estimate on your kitchen, cabinets or trim.
